blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to scale both in size and capabilities, their proficiency in the Arabic Language has seen significant advancement. However, a critical gap remains: the extent of their factual knowledge and cultural sensitivity to the diverse Arabic-speaking world remains largely underexplored. Current evaluation metrics often focus on translation or generic reasoning, failing to capture the rich historical, social, and regional nuances inherent to Arabic culture.
In addition, most benchmarks rely on heavy work, with human intervention in some steps, making the evaluation of knowledge coverage expensive and slow.
To address this deficiency, we introduce AraDynFact, a novel dynamic evaluation framework designed to rigorously assess the factual Arabic knowledge embedded in LLMs. Unlike static benchmarks, AraDynFact employs a dynamic approach to extract factual information and generate rich and answerable questions in a fast and automatic way.
We apply AraDynFact to Arabic Wikipedia and audit the performance of several state-of-the-art models, ranging from Arabic-centric specialized LLMs to high-resource general purpose LLMs. In addition we found a high degree of correlation with existing, hand-crafted Arabic-centric benchmarks, confirming the potential of our dynamic approach.
blocks.zh:
随着大语言模型(LLMs)在规模和能力上继续扩大,他们对阿拉伯语的熟练程度有了显著的进步. 然而,仍然存在一个重大差距:他们对于讲多种阿拉伯语世界的事实知识和文化敏感性的程度在很大程度上仍然没有得到充分利用。 目前的评价衡量标准往往侧重于翻译或一般推理,未能抓住阿拉伯文化固有的丰富的历史、社会和地区微妙之处。
此外,大多数基准依赖于繁重的工作,在某些步骤中采取人为干预,使得对知识覆盖面的评价既昂贵又缓慢.
为了弥补这一不足,我们引入了AraDynFact,这是一个新的动态评价框架,旨在严格评估LLMs中包含的阿拉伯事实知识。 与静态基准不同,AraDynFact采用了动态方法来提取事实信息,以快速自动的方式产生丰富且可回答的问题.
我们把 AraDynFact 应用到阿拉伯语维基百科,并审计从以阿拉伯为中心的专业LLM到高资源通用LLM的几种最新模型的性能. 此外,我们发现与现有的、以阿拉伯为中心手工制作的基准具有高度的相关性,这证实了我们动态方法的潜力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance in recent years, achieving unprecedented levels of understanding and reasoning in a variety of languages Meta AI (2026) . Recent efforts in both general and Arabic-centric LLMs are serving the needs of the Arabic-speaking community.
Numerous benchmarks have been introduced to assess the capabilities and coverage in general knowledge Elfilali et al. (2024) ; Alwajih et al. (2025) ; Boussaha et al. (2025) , Science ( Boussaha et al., 2025 , 3LM) , Trustworthiness ( Alghamdi et al., 2025 , AraTrust) , Legal ( Abu Shairah et al., 2025 , ALARB) , etc.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLM)近年来取得了显著的成绩,在多种语言Meta AI(2026)中实现了前所未有的理解和推理水平. 最近在一般和以阿拉伯语为中心的地方教育学院的努力正在满足阿拉伯语社区的需求。
采用了许多基准来评估Elfilali等人(2024年)、Alwajih等人(2025年)、Boussaha等人(2025年)、Science(Boussaha等人,2025年、3LM),可信赖性(Alghamdi等人,2025年、AraTrust),Legal(Abu Shairah等人,2025年、ALARB)等一般知识的能力和覆盖范围。

blocks.en: These datasets are often static, manually annotated, or derived from existing knowledge in larger LLMs, resulting in the evaluation of effectively stale data (data that is outdated and no longer maintained due to the cessation of data collection or ingestion).
blocks.zh: 这些数据集往往是静态的,手动附加说明的,或者从较大的LLMs中的现有知识中衍生出来的,导致对有效陈旧的数据(数据已经过时,由于数据收集或摄入停止而不再保留)进行评价.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Pipeline of AraDynFact. A) Documents are decomposed into paragraphs. B) From these paragraphs, atomic facts are extracted, and Named Entity Recognition (NER) is performed to identify the most important concepts and entities in the documents. C) Next, fact decontextualization is performed to make the facts self-contained. D) Using both the extracted facts and the original document, questions are then formulated. E) Finally, a grader evaluates the facts, questions, and answers to assess their correctness.
blocks.zh: 图1:AraDynFact的管道 A)文件分解成段落. B) 从这些段落中提取原子事实,并进行命名实体识别(NER),以确定文件中最重要的概念和实体. C) 其次,事实解密是为了使事实自成一体。 (d) 减少 然后利用所提取的事实和原始文件,提出问题。 E) 最后,一个分级员评价事实,问题,和答案以评估其正确性.

blocks.en: One potential mitigation for this issue is the emerging trend of dynamic benchmarking Chen et al. (2025) , which has shown promise as an alternative and has also been proposed to address data leakage.
blocks.zh: 对这一问题的一个潜在缓解是Chen等人(2025年)的动态基准的新兴趋势,这一趋势表明,作为一种替代办法,有希望,也有人提议解决数据泄漏问题。

blocks.en:
Some approaches have proposed to construct datasets with a particular cutoff date, Ying et al. (2024) ; White et al. (2025) , indicating until when the data was effectively collected. Ying et al. (2024) proposed a dataset that generates an automatic dataset, while providing online analysis regarding its effectiveness. Others Huang et al. (2025) propose to dynamically produce datasets for benchmarking.
These approaches are generally linked to a particular knowledge resource, and most of them are designed to operate exclusively in English.
blocks.zh:
一些方法建议构建一个特定截止日期的数据集,Ying等人(2024年);White等人(2025年),表示直到数据得到有效收集为止。 扬等. (2024年)提议建立一个数据集,生成自动数据集,同时对其有效性提供在线分析. 其它的黄等人(2025年)则提议动态制作数据集用于基准.
这些方法一般与特定的知识资源相关联,大多数是专用英语设计的.

blocks.en: To address this gap, we propose AraDynFact, an Arabic-centric dynamic benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the factual knowledge of both general-purpose and Arabic-focused language models. We introduce a new pipeline for extracting atomic and relevant facts from a data source, as well as a novel method for formulating questions from one or more of these facts.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议采用以阿拉伯为中心的动态基准AraDynFact,专门用来评价对通用和以阿拉伯为重点的语言模式的实际了解。 我们采用了从数据来源中提取原子和相关事实的新管道,以及从其中一个或多个事实中提出问题的新方法。

blocks.en: Our pipeline has been extensively tested on various Arabic sources, and the resulting benchmark is aligned with the most popular existing Arabic benchmarks. We present an evaluation of several general-purpose and Arabic-centric LLMs and compare their performance with existing Arabic (static) benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们的管道在各种阿拉伯语来源上进行了广泛的测试,由此得出的基准与最受欢迎的现有阿拉伯语基准一致。 我们提出对若干通用和以阿拉伯为中心的有限责任公司的评价,并将其业绩与现有的阿拉伯(静态)基准进行比较。

blocks.en: To our knowledge, no dynamic benchmark has been specifically designed to assess the capabilities of Arabic-capable language models.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,没有专门制定动态基准来评估阿拉伯语能力模式的能力。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce AraDynFact, a new benchmark that dynamically generates a set of questions to assess the knowledge coverage of a particular datasource. • We introduce a new pipeline for extracting atomic and relevant facts from a datasource and a new way to formulate questions from one or many of them. • We present an evaluation of several general and Arabic-centric LLMs and compare them with existing Arabic (static) benchmarks.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们介绍了AraDynFact,这是一个新的基准,它动态地产生一系列问题,以评估特定数据来源的知识覆盖范围。 我们引入了从数据来源中提取原子和相关事实的新管道,并引入了从其中一个或多个来源中提出问题的新方法。 我们评价了若干以阿拉伯为中心的普通课程,并与现有的阿拉伯(静态)基准进行比较。

blocks.en: We introduce AraDynFact, a new benchmark that dynamically generates a set of questions to assess the knowledge coverage of a particular datasource.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了AraDynFact,这个新的基准能动态生成一组问题来评估特定数据源的知识覆盖范围.

blocks.en: We introduce a new pipeline for extracting atomic and relevant facts from a datasource and a new way to formulate questions from one or many of them.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了从数据来源中提取原子和相关事实的新管道,以及从其中一个或多个来源中提出问题的新方法。

blocks.en: We present an evaluation of several general and Arabic-centric LLMs and compare them with existing Arabic (static) benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了若干以阿拉伯为中心的普通课程,并与现有的阿拉伯(静态)基准进行比较。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Arabic-specific Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.1 针对特定阿拉伯语的评价

blocks.en:
The evaluation of Arabic-capable LLMs is an active area of intense research. While many benchmarks are translations of existing ones, some are gathered and designed from scratch. Among the most known benchmarks we can cite Open Arabic LLMs Leaderboard ( Elfilali et al., 2024 , OALL) is the de-facto standard evaluation to evaluate the capabilities of LLMs in Arabic. It combines several existing Arabic benchmarks including AlGhafa, ACVA, Arabic MMLU, and Arabic EXAMS, covering tasks such as reading comprehension, sentiment analysis, question answering, and multiple-choice evaluation.
Another recently introduced benchmark is Palm: A Culturally Inclusive and Linguistically Diverse Dataset for Arabic LLMs ( Alwajih et al., 2025 ) , to date the widest benchmark specifically designed for all varieties of the Arabic Language, covering 20 topics, including culturally informed instructions from dialectal varieties of all 22 Arab countries and from Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). ArabCulture ( Sadallah et al., 2025 ) is a culturally grounded commonsense reasoning dataset in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), covering 13 Arab countries across the Gulf, Levant, North Africa, and the Nile Valley. The dataset contains 3,482 multiple-choice instances that test cultural commonsense reasoning in real-world daily life situations.
AraTrust ( Alghamdi et al., 2025 ) was designed to systematically evaluate how trustworthy large language models are when handling Arabic-language inputs. It focuses on measuring key dimensions of trustworthiness such as factual accuracy, bias, safety, and reliability across different types of Arabic prompts (including cultural and domain-specific questions).
Finally, 3LM ( Boussaha et al., 2025 ) has been introduced, 3LM ( \AR علم, science or knowledge in Arabic) is the first Arabic-native benchmark dedicated to scientific reasoning from Arabic educational materials such as biology, physics, chemistry, math, geography and programming.
blocks.zh:
对具有阿拉伯语能力的LLMs的评价是一个活跃的研究领域。 虽然许多基准是现有基准的翻译,但有些基准是从零开始收集和设计的。 在已知的基准中,我们可以引用Open Arab LLMs Leaderboard(Elfilali等人,2024年,OALL)是用来评价LLMs的阿拉伯文能力的事实上的标准评价. 它综合了包括Al-Ghafa、ACVA、阿拉伯MMLU和阿拉伯EXAMS在内的若干现有阿拉伯语基准,涵盖阅读理解、情绪分析、问答和多选择评价等任务。
最近采用的另一个基准是Palm:阿拉伯语LLMs(Alwajih等人,2025年)的文化包容性和语言多样性数据集,这是迄今专门为阿拉伯语所有品种设计的最广泛的基准,涵盖20个专题,包括所有22个阿拉伯国家的方言品种和现代标准阿拉伯语(MSA)提供文化上知情的指示。 阿拉伯文化(Sadallah等人,2025年)是现代标准阿拉伯语中基于文化的常识推理数据集,涵盖海湾、黎凡特、北非和尼罗河谷的13个阿拉伯国家。 该数据集包含3,482个多选择案例,在现实生活中测试文化常识推理.
AraTrust(Alghamdi等人,2025年)旨在系统评价在处理阿拉伯语投入时大语言模型的可信赖性。 它侧重于衡量可信赖性的关键方面,如事实准确性、偏见、安全性以及不同类型阿拉伯提示的可靠性(包括文化和领域具体问题)。
最后,引入了3LM(Boussaha等人,2025年),3LM(\AR علم,阿拉伯语科学或知识)是第一个阿拉伯语本土基准,专门从生物学,物理,化学,数学,地理和编程等阿拉伯语教育材料中进行科学推理.

blocks.en: 2.2 Dynamic Evaluation of LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 有限责任公司动态评价

blocks.en:
Ying et al. (2024) proposed a method that generates an automatic dataset, thus mitigating the issue of data leakage, while providing online analysis regarding its effectiveness.
DataGen ( Huang et al., 2025 ) on the other hand, proposes to dynamically produce datasets for benchmarking: a sophisticated framework is designed to produce high-quality synthetic datasets. This approach uses attribute-guided modules and retrieval-augmented techniques to ensure that the information remains factual and diverse. Our approach is similar in spirit to that proposed by Huang et al. (2025) , but AraDynFact is specifically aimed at the evaluation of Arabic factual knowledge from potentially any data source.
blocks.zh:
扬等. (2024年)提出了一个生成自动数据集的方法,从而减轻了数据泄漏的问题,同时对其有效性提供在线分析.
另一方面,DataGen(Huang等人,2025年)则提议动态生成用于基准的数据集:设计了一个复杂的框架,以生成高质量的合成数据集. 这种方法使用属性指导模块和检索强化技术,以确保信息保持事实性和多样性。 我们的方法在精神上与黄等人(2025年)提出的方法相似,但AraDynFact专门旨在评估可能来自任何数据来源的阿拉伯事实知识。

blocks.en: 2.3 Fact Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.3 事实提取

blocks.en:
Several approaches include fact extraction, a way to individualize pieces of information that can be verified independently, within their pipelines.
FActScore ( Min et al., 2023 ) decomposes long-form generations into a series of atomic facts and computes the percentage of these facts supported by a reliable knowledge resource. The approach estimates factuality by combining retrieval with a strong language model to verify individual claims with high precision. Our Fact extraction process is inspired by their approach.
Another approach that utilizes fact extraction is Factcheck-Bench ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . The work introduces a new document-level benchmark to evaluate automatic fact-checkers, focusing on the verifiability of claim-based segments using external evidence retrieved from search engines.
blocks.zh:
几种方法包括事实提取,这是将可以独立核实的、在其管道内的信息个别化的一种方法。
FActScore(Min等人,2023年)将长形代分解为一系列原子事实,并计算这些事实中得到可靠知识资源支持的百分比. 这种方法通过将检索与强有力的语文模型相结合,以高度精确地核实个人索赔要求,来估计实际性。 我们的事实提取过程受到他们方法的启发。
另一种利用事实提取的方法是Factcheck-Bench(Wang等人,2024年)。 这项工作引入了一个新的文件级基准,用于评价自动事实核对器,重点是利用从搜索引擎中获取的外部证据对索赔部分进行核查。

blocks.en: 2.4 Decontextualization
blocks.zh: 2.4 非文本化

blocks.en: Decontextualization is the process by which a piece of text can be properly interpreted without the lack of external information. Specifically, to make the piece of text self-contained. Some research pieces have been conducted on this issue from which we drew inspiration while developing AraDynFact.
blocks.zh: 十写法(Decontextalization)是一块文字在不缺乏外部信息的情况下能够正确解释的过程. 具体地说,使文本的片段自成一体. 已经就这一问题进行了一些研究,我们在开发AraDynFact时从中获得了灵感。

blocks.en: In the seminal work introduced by Choi et al. (2021) , the authors developed an annotation method and trained automated models to translate regular sentences into a self-contained form. The work output includes a dataset containing triplets (sentence, context, decontextualized_sentence) that were used to train two different models: i) a BERT-like model to approach the decontextualization as coreference resolution problem, and ii) a SeqToSeq model ( Raffel et al., 2020 , T5) , approaching decontextualization as a translation task.
blocks.zh: 在Choi等人介绍的开创性作品(2021)中,作者开发了注解方法,并训练了自动模型,将常规句子转化为自成一体的形式. 工作产出包括一个包含三胞胎(判决,上下文,解密)的数据集,用于训练两种不同的模型:一)一种类似BERT的模型,将解密作为共引解问题处理;二)一种SeqToSeq模型(Raffel等人,2020,T5),作为翻译任务接近解密.

blocks.en: 3 The AraDynFact Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3. AraDynFact基准

blocks.en:
Given a knowledge resource and a model, the objective is to assess how much information from the resource is contained in the model.
The resource is dynamically analyzed to extract factual information. The facts are then used to generate queries that are fed to the model.
Finally, the answers are compared with the original passages from the resource to check their validity. All the steps were carried out using Qwen3-235B-A22B Qwen Team (2025) with prompts specifically designed to the tasks. The prompts are present in the Appendix.
Figure 1 presents an overview of the whole procedure. Below we will explain in depth each step:
blocks.zh:
鉴于知识资源和模型,目标是评估模型中包含多少资源信息。
对资源进行了动态分析,以提取事实信息。 然后利用这些事实来生成提供给模型的查询.
最后,将答案与原始资源段落进行比较,以检查其有效性。 所有步骤均使用Qune3-235B-A22B Quen Team(2025)进行,并有专为任务设计的提示. 提示载于附录。
图1概述了整个程序。 下面我们将深入解释每个步骤:

blocks.en: 3.1 Fact Extraction Process
blocks.zh: 3.1 实况调查进程

blocks.en: The fact extraction is itself composed of several sub-tasks: decomposition, atomic fact extraction, named entity recognition, decontextualization and refinement. Decomposition. The document is divided into paragraphs and later into individual sentences. Atomic fact extraction. From each isolated sentence, the system distills atomic facts—the smallest units of information that can be verified independently. Named Entity Recognition. This process identifies and categorizes salient concepts, such as individuals, organizations, locations, and dates. Decontextualization. From the original paragraph, entities and atomic facts, the latter are rewritten to make them self-contained. Refinement. Decontextualized sentences are processed to prevent them from becoming too verbose.
blocks.zh: 事实提取本身由几个子任务组成:分解,原子事实提取,命名实体识别,解编和完善. 解说. 文件分为几段,后分为个别句子. 原子事实提取. 从每一个孤立的句子中,系统会提炼原子事实——可以独立核实的最小的信息单位. 命名为实体识别 。 这一过程确定并分类了突出的概念,如个人、组织、地点和日期。 解字义. 从原始段落,实体和原子事实中,后者被改写,使其自成一体. 精进精进. 解码句被处理,以防止它们变成太动词.

blocks.en: 3.2 Question Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 问题产生

blocks.en:
Once the fact list is completely processed we conduct the dynamic generation of questions.
The process receives a list of facts from a single document and it generates as many self-contained questions as possible. For each question, the process assigns (a) a task taxonomy and (b) a difficulty level.
Four types were used as possible questions tasks:
blocks.zh:
一旦事实清单得到彻底处理,我们就进行动态的提问。
这一过程从单一文件中收到一份事实清单,并产生尽可能多的自足问题。 对于每个问题,过程会分配(a)任务分类和(b)难度等级.
四种类型作为可能的问题任务:

blocks.en: Factoid QA. Questions that can be generally answered with an entity. They are generally made from just one fact. Explanatory QA. Questions that require an explanation linking two or more facts. Causal Why/How QA. The questions from this type are simply formatted as Why/How questions. The answer might not be an entity rather a longer piece of text. Comparative QA. The answers of these questions need to address properties of one or more entities.
blocks.zh: 事实QA. 通常可以由一个实体回答的问题。 它们一般只是由一个事实造成的。 解释性质量保证。 需要解释两个或两个以上事实的问题。 (原始内容存档于2017-03-27). Causal Why/ how QA. 这种类型的问题只是被简单地格式化为“为什么/为什么问题”。 答案可能不是一个实体,而是一个较长的案文。 比较质量保证。 这些问题的答案需要涉及一个或多个实体的属性.

blocks.en:
Each question is also classified in three levels of difficulty, low , medium and high 1 1 1 In the prompt we used medium, high and
very_high as potential options and mapped the three levels accordingly .
blocks.zh:
每个问题也分为三个层次:低、中、高11。
高度是潜在的选项,并据此绘制了三个级别。

blocks.en: low : Direct retrieval or light structuring from selected facts. medium : This option aims to combine multiple facts or requires multi-step reasoning fully supported by the facts. high : Most difficult questions, made with careful constraints, multi-part answer, or subtle synthesis fully determined by the facts.
blocks.zh: 低 : 从选定的事实直接检索或光线结构。 介质 : 这一选择旨在综合多种事实,或需要由事实所充分支持的多步骤推理. 高:最难的问题,用仔细的制约,多段的回答,或由事实充分决定的微妙综合.

blocks.en: Given the strong correlation between the number of facts involved and the reasoning steps required, Factoid questions, typically derived from a single fact, tend to be more straightforward. Although they may still require basic retrieval and understanding, they generally do not demand multi-step reasoning. For this reason, the majority of Factoid questions are classified as low difficulty rather than medium , as they involve limited compositional reasoning.
blocks.zh: 鉴于所涉事实数量与所需推理步骤之间有很强的关联性,Factoid问题通常来自单一的事实,往往更为直接。 虽然它们可能需要基本的检索和理解,但一般不需要多步骤推理. 因此,大多数Factoid问题被归类为低难度而非中等难度,因为这些问题涉及有限的组成推理。

blocks.en: 3.3 Answering and grading
blocks.zh: 3.3 答复和叙级

blocks.en:
We follow the standard response generation evaluation strategy. Questions are presented to the models under evaluation using a chat template.
Since by construction the questions are self-contained, no further context is provided. The knowledge needed to answer the questions should be encoded already within model’s weights. In this way, given a data source, we can dynamically assess the knowledge coverage of any language model.
blocks.zh:
我们遵循标准的反应生成评价战略。 使用聊天模板向评价中的模型提问。
由于这些问题是自成一体的,因此没有提供进一步的背景。 回答问题所需的知识应该已经在模型的权重范围内编码。 这样,如果有数据来源,我们可以动态地评估任何语言模型的知识覆盖范围。

blocks.en: LLM-as-a-Judge
blocks.zh: LLM 现职法官

blocks.en:
Once all the questions have been answered by the models under evaluation, the grading process begins. Because the questions are dynamically generated, there is no single canonical “gold” answer for each one. Instead, the evaluation relies on the set of facts used to generate the question, which serves as the reference for assessing the correctness of the responses. We also rely on Qwen3-235B-A22B Qwen Team (2025) as our Judge model. For evaluation itself, we adopt the strategy, and used the prompt, introduced in Wei et al. (2024, SimpleQA) , where each model-generated answer is assigned one of three labels: CORRECT , INCORRECT , or NOT_ATTEMPTED .
In the case of CORRECT responses, the answer must fully incorporate all the key information from the fact list used to create the question, while maintaining internal consistency. INCORRECT responses are those that either provide partial information, omit critical facts, or contain statements that directly contradict the reference facts. Finally, responses labeled NOT_ATTEMPTED correspond to cases where the model explicitly indicates uncertainty (e.g., by stating “I don’t know”) or Produces a response that introduces no factual content beyond what is already contained in the question.
blocks.zh:
一旦所有问题都得到所评价模式的回答,分级过程便开始。 由于问题是动态产生的,因此每个问题都没有单一的“金色”答案。 相反,评价依靠用来产生问题的一套事实,作为评估答复正确性的参考。 我们还依靠Qune3-235B-A22B Quen Team(2025年)作为我们的法官模式. 对于评价本身,我们采用了Wei等人(2024年,SimpleQA)中引入的战略,并使用了即时,其中每个模型生成的答案被分配到三个标签之一:CORRECT,INCORRET,或NOT_ATTEPTED。
就CORREECT答复而言,答复必须充分纳入用于制造问题的事实清单中的所有关键信息,同时保持内部一致性。 不一致的答复,是指提供部分信息,省略关键事实,或包含与参考事实直接矛盾的陈述的答复. 最后,标注为NOT_ATEMPTED的答复,与模型明确指明不确定性(例如,说明 " 我不知道 " )或提出答复的情况相对应,答复除了问题中已经包含的内容之外,没有提出任何事实内容。

blocks.zh: 表1:在阿拉伯语维基百科上进行的实验的准确性与四种类型不同的问题难度. 高难度的真人问题很少见(只有6个事件).

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We tested our pipeline on 2026 dump of Arabic Wikipedia. The Arabic Wikipedia 2 2 2 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabic_Wikipedia. ( \AR ويكيبيديا العربية), is the version of Wikipedia written in Modern Standard Arabic. As of March 2026, it contained more than 1.3 million articles, ranking 15th in terms of number of articles among Wikipedias. As versions from different languages, articles are generally attached with categories. We kept all articles linked at first or second level from the category Middle East ( \AR تصنيف:الشرق الأوسط) resulting in almost 60k articles.
These articles contained approximately 600k paragraphs, where 10 million atomic facts were extracted.

The question generation process produced approximately 340k different questions and we sampled uniformly 5% of the corpus and filtered trivial (extremely short) questions, resulting in 13064 questions, which we used in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 问题生成过程产生了大约340k个不同的问题,我们统一抽取了5%的命题,并过滤了细小(极短)的问题,结果产生了13064个问题,我们在实验中使用了这些问题.

blocks.en: 4.1 Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 结果

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows an analysis of the four types of questions run on 17 standard models, both Arabic-centric and general models.
For Arabic models, we analyze Fanar Team et al. () , ALLaM Bari et al. (2025) , Yehia Navid-AI (2025) , SILMA silma-ai (2024) and Command-R7B-Arabic Alnumay et al. (2025) . For the English models, we included different sizes of Qwen3 Qwen Team (2025) , Llama Grattafiori et al. (2024) ; Meta AI (2026) , two distilled versions of DeepSeek R1 Guo et al. (2025) , Gemma 3 Gemma Team (2025) and GPT-OSS Agarwal et al. (2025)
blocks.zh:
表1对17个标准模型上运行的四类问题进行了分析,既有以阿拉伯语为中心的,也有一般模型.
对于阿拉伯语模型,我们分析Fanar Team等人(),AllaM Bari等人(2025年),Yehia Navid-AI (2025年),SILMA silma-ai (2024年)和Command-R7B-Arabic Alnumay等人(2025年). 对于英语模型,我们包括了不同大小的Qune3 Quen Team(2025),Llama Grattafiori等人(2024),Meta AI(2026),DeepSeek R1 Guo等人(2025),Gemma 3 Gemma Team(2025)和GPT-OSS Agarwal等人(2025)两个蒸馏版本.

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the performance of 17 large language models across the four question types defined in AraDynFact (Factoid QA, Explanatory QA, Causal Why/How QA, and Comparative QA), each broken down by three difficulty levels: low, medium and high. Below the difficulty, we include the number of questions generated for each type/difficulty. As it is easy to notice, Factoid questions tend to be easier than the other types, which is represented in the bias towards low-difficulty questions. The majority of the questions from other types fall into the medium difficultly. The rarity of high-difficulty Factoid QA questions makes the indicator for that category unreliable. The remaining categories show a more reasonable distribution.
blocks.zh: 表1列出了在AraDynFact(Factoid QA,解释性QA,Causal Why/How QA,比较性QA)中定义的四个问题类型中,17个大语言模型的性能,每个模型按低,中,高三个难度级别细分. 在困难之下,我们列出为每一种/困难产生的问题的数目。 由于容易发现,Factoid问题往往比其他类型容易,这表现为偏向低难度问题. 其他类型的问题大多难以解决。 高度困难的Factoid QA问题很少,使得该类别的指标不可靠。 其余类别显示分布更为合理。

blocks.en:
Regarding the models, they are grouped into two categories: Arabic-centric (Fanar-1-9B, ALLaM-7B, Yehia-7B, SILMA-9B, and Command-R7B-Arabic) and general-purpose (various sizes of Qwen3, Llama, DeepSeek-R1 distillations, Gemma 3, and GPT-OSS).
Overall scores remain modest in all models and question types, with most values falling in the 0.20 to 0.45 range, reflecting the inherent difficulty of the benchmark. Among the top performers, larger general models such as GPT-OSS-120B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B, Llama-3.3-70B, and Gemma-3-27B consistently achieve the highest scores, suggesting that scale remains a dominant factor even for Arabic factual knowledge. In contrast, smaller models, both Arabic-centric and general, such as SILMA-9B, Llama-3.1-8B, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, tend to underperform across all question types.
Arabic-centric models generally outperform general-purpose models of comparable size, with the exception of SILMA-9B. This indicates that, while specialized Arabic training may be beneficial, it does not necessarily guarantee superior factual coverage on this benchmark.
Performance on high-difficulty questions is particularly volatile, with several models scoring near zero, likely due to the limited number of instances at that level. Scores are broadly consistent across question types within each model, though Comparative and Causal questions tend to surface slightly more variance, consistent with their higher compositional reasoning demands.
blocks.zh:
关于这些模型,它们被分为两类:以阿拉伯文为中心的(Fanar-1-9B、AllaM-7B、Yehia-7B、SILMA-9B和Command-R7B-Arabic)和通用(各种尺寸的Qune3、Llama、DeepSeek-R1蒸馏、Gemma 3和GPT-OSS)。
在所有模型和问题类型中,总的分数仍然不高,大多数值在0.20到0.45之间,反映了基准的固有困难. 在成绩最好的人中,较大的一般型号,如GPT-OSS-120B,DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B,Llama-33-70B,以及Gemma-3-27B等,都一贯达到最高分数,这表明,即使对阿拉伯语的事实知识来说,比例表仍然是一个主导因素. 相比之下,以阿拉伯为中心的小型模型和通用模型,如SILMA-9B,Llama-3.1-8B,以及DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B,往往在所有问题类型中表现不佳.
除SILMA-9B外,以阿拉伯为中心的模型一般都超过大小相当的通用模型. 这表明,虽然阿拉伯语专业培训可能是有益的,但不一定保证在这一基准上有更好的事实报道。
高难度问题的表现特别不稳定,几个模型的评分接近零,这可能是因为这一级的案例数量有限。 在每个模型中,问题类型之间的分数大致一致,尽管比较问题和因果关系问题往往出现稍大的差异,这符合它们较高的组成推理要求。

blocks.en: 5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en: Does AraDynFact correlate with models’ strength?
blocks.zh: AraDynFact是否与模型的力量相关?

blocks.en:
To validate this premise, we conducted two complementary experiments designed to assess both the internal consistency of our benchmark and its external alignment with established evaluation frameworks.
The first experiment focuses on scaling behavior. Specifically, we selected a model family released across multiple parameter sizes while sharing the same architecture, training data, and optimization regime. This setup allows us to control for confounding variables, since model size remains the primary factor that changes across variants. Under standard scaling laws, increasing the number of parameters should generally lead to improved performance, provided the evaluation benchmark is sufficiently sensitive to capture differences in reasoning capacity. Therefore, if AraDynFact is a reliable and well-calibrated benchmark, it should reflect a consistent and monotonic performance improvement as model size increases. In other words, larger models should systematically outperform their smaller counterparts. As illustrated in Figure 2 , the results confirm this expectation: performance on AraDynFact improves steadily with model scale, demonstrating that the benchmark is sensitive to model scale and consistent with established scaling laws.
blocks.zh:
为了证实这一前提,我们进行了两项补充试验,以评估我们基准的内部一致性及其与既定评价框架的外部一致性。
第一次实验的重点是放大行为. 具体来说,我们选择了一个跨多个参数大小的模型家族,同时共享相同的架构,培训数据和优化制度. 这种设置使我们能够控制混淆变量,因为模型大小仍然是不同变量变化的首要因素. 根据标准比例法,增加参数的数目一般应导致业绩的改善,但评价基准必须足够敏感,足以反映推理能力的差异。 因此,如果AraDynFact是可靠和精准的基准,它应该反映随着模型大小的增大而持续和单调性能的改善. 换句话说,较大的模型应系统地超过较小的模型。 如图2所示,结果证实了这一期望:AraDynFact的绩效随着模型尺度稳步改善,表明基准对模型尺度很敏感,符合既定的缩放法。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Visualization Qwen3 performance on increasingly model sizes.
blocks.zh: 图2:可视化 Qwen3在日益增强的模型尺寸上的性能.

blocks.en: Does AraDynFact correlate with existing benchmarks?
blocks.zh: AraDynFact是否与现有基准相关?

blocks.en: Our second verification step evaluates external validity by examining how AraDynFact correlates with existing Arabic-focused benchmarks. To this end, we selected a representative subset of tasks from the Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard ( Elfilali et al., 2024 , OALL) , including ArabicMMLU, Exams, MedinahQA, and AraTrust. These benchmarks collectively cover general knowledge, academic-style examinations, question answering, and trustworthiness evaluation. In addition, we incorporated two previously discussed benchmarks: 3LM Boussaha et al. (2025) , which emphasizes STEM-oriented reasoning, and ArabCulture Sadallah et al. (2025) , which focuses on culturally grounded commonsense reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们的第二个核查步骤通过审查AraDynFact如何与现有的以阿拉伯语为重点的基准挂钩来评价外部有效性。 为此,我们从开放的阿拉伯LLM领导板(Elfilali等人,2024年,OALL)中挑选了具有代表性的子集任务,包括阿拉伯MMLU、考试、麦迪纳QA和AraTrust。 这些基准包括一般知识、学术式考试、回答问题和可信度评价。 此外,我们纳入了先前讨论的两个基准:强调以STEM为导向推理的3LM Boussaha等人(2025年)和侧重于基于文化的常识推理的阿拉伯文化Sadallah等人(2025年)。

blocks.en: We computed the Spearman rank correlation coefficient across multiple large language models. As shown in Figure 3 , the results indicate strong positive correlations, suggesting that AraDynFact is well aligned with recognized evaluation standards. Importantly, unlike many static benchmarks, AraDynFact offers the additional advantage of dynamic generation, enabling continuous expansion and reduced risk of data leakage while maintaining agreement with established evaluation signals.
blocks.zh: 我们计算了Spearman在多种大语言模型中的 排名系数。 如图3所示,结果显示了强烈的正相关关系,表明AraDynFact完全符合公认的评价标准. 重要的是,与许多静态基准不同的是,AraDynFact提供了动态生成的额外优势,能够持续扩展并减少数据泄漏的风险,同时保持与既定评价信号的一致。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced AraDynFact, a dynamic evaluation framework for assessing the factual Arabic knowledge embedded within LLMs. By grounding evaluation in automatically extracted atomic facts from potentially any Arabic data source, and generating diverse questions across four types and three difficulty levels, AraDynFact offers a scalable and contamination-resistant alternative to static benchmarks.
Our comprehensive evaluation using Arabic Wikipedia as knowledge resource, across 17 models reveals a consistent pattern: while general-purpose LLMs often achieve competitive scores on linguistic and reasoning tasks, they exhibit notable gaps in localized factual accuracy and culturally specific knowledge about the Arabic-speaking world. Arabic-centric models, despite being trained on domain-relevant data, do not uniformly outperform their general counterparts, highlighting that scale and general pretraining remain strong factors even in culturally specific evaluation settings.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们引入了AraDynFact,这是一个动态评价框架,用于评估LLMs中包含的阿拉伯事实知识. AraDynFact通过对可能从任何阿拉伯数据来源中自动提取的原子事实进行基础评估,并产生涉及四类和三类难度的不同问题,提供了一种可伸缩和耐污染的替代静态基准。
我们利用阿拉伯语维基百科作为知识资源的全面评价,在17种模式中揭示出一种一致的模式:虽然通用的法学硕士经常在语言和推理任务上取得有竞争力的分数,但是在本地化的事实准确性和文化上对阿拉伯语世界有明显差距。 以阿拉伯文为中心的模型,尽管接受过有关域域数据的培训,但并没有统一地比一般的模型要好,强调规模和一般的预先培训即使在文化上具体的评价环境中仍然是强有力的因素。

blocks.en: We demonstrated that AraDynFact performance scales monotonically with model size within the same model family, confirming the benchmark’s sensitivity and reliability. Second, strong Spearman rank correlations with established Arabic benchmarks such as ArabicMMLU, AraTrust, and ArabCulture confirm that AraDynFact aligns well with recognized evaluation signals, while offering the added benefit of dynamic regeneration.
blocks.zh: 我们证明,AraDynFact的性能尺度是单调的,模型大小在同一模型家族中,证实了基准的敏感性和可靠性。 第二,强大的斯皮尔曼将阿拉伯基准(如阿拉伯MMLU、阿拉特雷特和阿拉伯文化)与既定的阿拉伯基准(如阿拉伯MMLU、阿拉特雷特和阿拉伯文化)的关联排序,证实阿拉丹事实与公认的评价信号吻合良好,同时提供了动态再生的额外好处。

blocks.en: We hope AraDynFact serves as a foundation for building more culturally aware and factually reliable Arabic AI systems, and encourage the community to extend the framework to additional Arabic knowledge sources and dialects beyond Modern Standard Arabic.
blocks.zh: 我们希望AraDynFact成为建立更具有文化意识和事实可靠性的阿拉伯语AI系统的基础,并鼓励社区将该框架扩大到超越现代标准阿拉伯语的其他阿拉伯语知识来源和方言。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: While our method shows potential and does correlate with existing datasets, there are limitations that are intrinsic to the pipeline process. Questions are generated from facts, answered by evaluated models and graded by a larger LLM. There are some occasions where the question is not completely answerable, or the grader fails to correctly judge the validity of an answer or identify its errors. We consider that in the long run, those errors even out and a reasonable evaluation of the factual knowledge is performed.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的方法显示出潜力,而且确实与现有数据集相关,但管道进程存在固有的局限性。 问题来自事实,由评价模型回答,并通过较大的LLM进行分级. 在某些情况下,问题不能完全回答,或者分级者未能正确判断答案的有效性或识别其错误. 我们认为,从长远来看,这些错误甚至被消除,对事实了解进行了合理的评估。
